description.value: Apollonia is an elegant 50-seat Greek restaurant steps from Granville Island, opened in 2002 by owners Niko and Poly and driven by the concept of philoxenia — the art of making a stranger a friend. The kitchen specialises in mainland Greek cuisine prepared simply and authentically, drawing on the hospitality traditions of a proper Greek home. Walk-ins are always welcome, and takeout is available by phone or through DoorDash.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for apolloniagreekrestaurant.com is fully accessible and confirms a 50-seat dine-in Greek restaurant at 1830 Fir Street, Vancouver BC V6J 3B1; the phone 604-736-9559 appears multiple times and matches OSM. A key concern is that OSM records the name as 'Apollinia' while the website and all page titles consistently spell it 'Apollonia.' Takeout is explicitly confirmed via the /order page (DoorDash delivery and phone pickup); no bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name 'Apollinia' does not match the business's own consistent spelling 'Apollonia' across all website pages and page titles — the OSM tag likely contains a typo.
OSM opening_hours (Tu-Su 16:00-21:30) conflicts with website hours (closed Sunday and Monday; Friday-Saturday close at 10:00 PM rather than 9:30 PM) — OSM hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a real, active restaurant near the popular Granville Island cycling area and is a plausible WWC food stop, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence — a site visit or direct contact is needed before listing.
